name: Savor the Sting
text:
You inflict pain upon the target and revel in their anguish. This deals 1d4 mental damage and @item.leveld4 persistent,mental damage; the target must attempt a Will save. As long as the target is taking persistent damage from this spell, you gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and skill checks against the target.

---
Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage and no persistent damage.

Failure The target takes full initial and persistent damage.

Spell Effect: Savor the Sting

Critical Failure The target takes double initial and persistent damage.

---
Heightened (+1) The initial damage increases by 1d4 and the persistent damage increases by 1d4.
